Get Started FIX IT QUICK: HANDYMAN SERVICES LLC Home Services Pricing / Rates Photo Gallery About Contact Provide Feedback PRICING / RATES At Fix It Quick: Handyman Services LLC, we provide you with a free estimate, on site in person, but also over the phone if preferable to the client. Flexible options are provided so that budget concerns don’t get in the way of your repair/assembly needs. Call me to learn more about service rates. PRICING INCREMENTS OF $20 (NO HIDDEN FEES) Any service provided by us will be in increments of $20. Pricing is based on the complexity, size, and quantity of the project. ​ Projects will not be based upon where you live (within servicing area), retail price, and a hourly rate OUTSIDE OF SERVICE AREA, WE CAN STILL HELP! We get that sometimes you may not have the assistance that you need locally to get your home project done, and Fix It Quick is still here for you. For every mile between the edge of our service area and the destination, we charge a fee of $3 per mile. NOTICE: The main services provided by Fix It Quick are listed on the Services Page. For any other special task services that you may have and we are able to complete upon an agreement, an on-site assessment is required. ​ ​ Servicable Area: Richmond City, Chesterfield, Henrico, Hanover, Ashland, Chester, Colonial Heights, Petersburg, Prince George, Goochland, Powhatan, Midlothian, Prince George, Short Pump, Sandston, Highland Springs, Hopewell Email: fixitquickrva@gmail.com Contact Number: (804)393-1391 ©2020 by Fix It Quick: Handyman Services LLC. Get Started FIX IT QUICK: HANDYMAN SERVICES LLC Home Services Pricing / Rates Photo Gallery About Contact Provide Feedback IT'S MY PLEASURE TO HELP!! Thank you for choosing Fix it Quick: Handyman Services. Here is a little bit about myself that I would love to share with you. Originally from Halifax, VA, I come from a long line of handymen, stemming from my grandfathers, uncles, and cousins. You could definitely say that putting things together has always been in my blood. Raised in Richmond, VA since the age of 6, later on in life I attended high school at Maggie L. Walker Governor’s School for Government and International Studies, earning an advanced high school diploma. Pursuing a college education after high school, I graduated from Virginia Commonwealth University in 2012 with a BS in Mechanical Engineering as well as a BS in Physics. I have since transitioned to the handyman sector for now, as understanding the needs of servicing others and having a deep and driven passion for helping people is something that was passed down to me from my father. Since I was 8 years old, I would "help" him do handyman work around the house as I was the only boy and didn't really have a choice. That experience really helped shaped me into the man that I am today as I know and understand the importance of home maintenance and upkeep. I finally made the decision to help people on my own. Even though I'm no longer doing anything with engineering, my extensive background in the sciences shows the great amount of time and detail that will be put into work projects and making sure that clients are serviced in an efficient manner. ​ “I adhere to making sure I keep everything short, sweet, and simple with clients! It’s my responsibility to take care of customers in the most efficient manner. When we all play our part, everyone benefits.” ​ Now that you've learned a little about me, let me learn how I can help you! Call today! ​ Jonathan Monroe, Owner Fix It Quick Handyman Services ​ Get in Touch Email: fixitquickrva@gmail.com Contact Number: (804)393-1391 ©2020 by Fix It Quick: Handyman Services LLC.
